name: System Owner/User Discovery
description:
Identify System owner or users on an endpoint

Upon successful execution, sh will stdout list of usernames.

mapping_evidence.note: Log source corrected from "audit" (auditd, not present on this endpoint) to "process_creation": snoopy execve telemetry surfaced by JISRSEC rule 100110, validated with wazuh-logtest.
